meta.description: The staged migration plan, ordered by blast radius (lowest-risk pilot first). Each wave is a SET OF MUTATIONS to apply to baseline.json, plus the two-part proof wave-check.py runs after applying it: (a) no legitimate admin is locked out, (b) the targeted PATH-001 hop is now dead. This is the worked-example wave plan; the learner authors their own migration-runbook.md and may reorder.
meta.model: strangler-fig: scaffold beside flat -> pilot one OU -> prove -> widen wave by wave -> retire flat last
